Name: ValleyTalk for SVE
Author: dandm1
Description:
A Content Patcher content pack for ValleyTalk - Infinite Dialogue which adds support for SVE Characters, Places and Relationships.  The mod includes 23 additional character biographies for the major SVE characters, as well as adding location details and relationships into the overall Stardew Valley game profile.

For the main ValleyTalk mod see: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30319]Valley Talk - Infinite Dialogue[/url]
For the main Stardew Valley Expanded mod see: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]

[b][u][size=4]Installation Instructions[/size][/u][/b]
This mod is a Content Patcher expansion for ValleyTalk. 

Before you can install it you need to have ValleyTalk v1.0.0 or later installed.  You should also have Stardew Valley Expanded installed (strictly it will work without SVE - but there's no point).

Simply unzip the zip file into your Mods folder and Content Patcher will add the additional characters, locations and relationships into the game when it loads.
[size=4]
[/size][b][u][size=4]About ValleyTalk[/size][/u][/b]
ValleyTalk uses the power of modern AI to make Stardew Valley conversations immersive in a way that was not possible previously. Talk to your spouse about options for home schooling your children, discuss your latest finds in the mines, have the villagers remember you are married when you give them a gift, let the villagers refer to each other when talking in a group – the options are endless.

[u][b][size=4]ValleyTalk Features[/size]
[/b][/u][size=2]Features of the base ValleyTalk mod include:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]When talking to any villager they will react based on friendship level and season as normal, as well as other factors including weather, time of day, where they are standing, who else is present, community events, bundle completion, how they feel about any gift they've been given and their history with the player.[/size]
[*][size=2]When talking to a spouse they will also be aware of buildings, animals and crops currently on the farm, pets, children, happiness in the marriage, how long they've been married, any other spouses (if using a polyamory mod) and more.[/size]
[*][size=2]You can respond to questions from villagers by typing your own response, or selecting from 3 or 4 options proposed by the LLM.[/size]
[*][size=2]Villagers and spouses remember past conversations and refer back to them in the future.[/size]
[*][size=2]All villagers respond in character.[/size]
[*][size=2]The farmer is able to have long back and forth conversations with the villagers, exploring aspects of their character and relationship.[/size]
[*][size=2]Can be run in conjunction with other dialogue mods and custom NPCs. With the ValleyTalk for SVE mod supports all core chracters from Stardew Valley and SVE.[/size]
[*][size=2]Works with all major large-language model providers, including free options.[/size]
[*][size=2]Combines contextually aware conversation with standard (or modded) dialogue for events and festivals.[/size]
[/list][size=4][u][b]Prerequisites[/b][/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]ValleyTalk 1.0.0 or later.[/size]
[*][size=2]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 [/size]
[*][size=2]SMAPI 4.1.7[/size]
[*][size=2](Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu 1.14.1 or later.[/size]
[*][size=2]Content Patcher 2.6.1 or later.[/size]
[/list][b][u][size=4]Rights[/size][/u][/b]
[list]

[*][size=2]You may reuse the structure to create content packs for any other Stardew Mods that you are creating or that others have created (subject to their rights).  [/size]
[*][size=2]You are free to create translations of this mod - let me know if you have any trouble with that.[/size]
[*][size=2]Generally it would be appreciated if you acknowledge my work in any variants of it you create.[/size]
[/list]
